h:
我自己正在变老，但电影奇怪的科学是一部 80 年代的喜剧，讲述了几个孤独、性欲旺盛的高中男孩的故事，他们将组件添加到计算机中，以制作出终极的 waifu。这是《早餐俱乐部》（导致他周末被拘留的事件）、《终结者》（比尔·帕克斯顿饰演的角色遇到 T-800 之前）和《钢铁侠》（小罗伯特·唐尼饰演高中时的托尼·斯塔克）的前传。如果历史学家认识到克里斯托弗·哥伦布发现了美洲，那么历史学家也会认识到约翰·休斯、凯利·勒布洛克，尤其是高中生发现了人工智能。 img2img。现实模仿艺术，你的爱人即将活过来。

该工作流程专门用于转换风格（绘画到照片、线条艺术到颜色、waifu 到现实等）。我可能会创建专门处理其他内容的额外 img2img 工作流程。这仅用于风格转换和图像一致性。

需要一些 SDXL ControlNet 模型。您需要这些来锁定源作品。不需要自定义节点，但 WD14 标记器（剪辑询问器）是可选的，但非常有用。下载以下模型并将其放入 ComfyUI\ models\ controlnet\ 文件夹中。使用 Manager（自定义）安装 WD14。

https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/control-lora/tree/main/control-LoRAs-rank256

源图像从 DeviantArt 盗取。抱歉，我知道他们有多讨厌这样。

o.en:
I'm aging myself, but the movieWeird Scienceis an 80s comedy about a couple of lonely, horny, high school boys, who add components into a computer in order to make the ultimate waifu. It's a prequel to The Breakfast Club (the events leading up to his weekend detention), Terminator (before Bill Paxton's character meets the T-800) and Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr plays Tony Stark in high school). If historians recognize that Christopher Columbus discovered America, then historians will recognize that John Hughes, Kelly LeBrock and, most of all, high school boys discovered A.I. img2img. Reality imitates art, and your waifus are about to come to life.

This workflow specializes in converting styles (painting to photograph, line art to color, waifu to reality, etc). I'll likely create additional img2img workflows that specialize in other stuff. This is meant solely for style conversion and image consistency.

A few SDXL ControlNet models are required. You need these to lock in source compositions. There's no custom nodes needed but WD14 tagger (clip interrogator) is optional but very helpful. Download the models below and put them in the ComfyUI\ models\ controlnet\ folder. Use Manager (custom) to install WD14.

https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/control-lora/tree/main/control-LoRAs-rank256

Source images stolen from DeviantArt. Sorry, I know how much they hate that.
